title: SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher does not perform sufficient request validation in certain administrative… (CVE-2026-120014)
description: SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher has insufficient request validation in certain administrative functions. An unauthenticated attacker can trick a logged-on administrator into clicking a malicious link, causing unintended actions within the administrator's session. This can temporarily compromise the SAP HANA XSA Web Dispatcher, impacting confidentiality highly and integrity and availability partially.
